environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed in a gVisor-sandboxed container (runsc runtime with --rootless flag) where the process root is pivot_root'd into /srv/app with a read-only overlayfs base layer. The /app/logs bind-mount targets a tmpfs volume (64MB, noexec, nosuid) that is NOT shared with any other service. Process runs as uid 65534 (nobody) with a seccomp-bpf profile (allowlist mode) that permits only: read, write, openat (restricted to paths matching /app/logs/*), fstat, close, mmap, brk, futex, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, accept4, socket (AF_INET only), clock_gettime, and rt_sigaction. The openat filter uses a BPF program that checks the pathname argument prefix against /app/logs/ and /app/config/ only - any openat call targeting other paths returns EACCES. Environment variables are injected via a Kubernetes sealed-secret with the env vars DATABASE_URL and STRIPE_SECRET_KEY replaced with vault:// references resolved at boot by a sidecar (the actual values never appear in process.env after initialization). The container has no /proc/self/environ readable (procfs not mounted). Network egress is blocked by a Cilium L3/L4 policy allowing only port 5432 to the RDS endpoint CIDR.
